customManagers.description: Track the maturin build tool version pinned inline in CI (pip install maturin==X.Y.Z); the built-in managers do not see this shell string, so without this it can silently drift from the maturin-action version

packageRules.description: Keep action digest updates reviewable as one batch

Low-risk auto-merge: non-major updates to CI infrastructure Actions that PR CI fully exercises. Fail-closed allowlist; build tools (maturin-action, setup-uv, rust-toolchain) and the PyPI publish Action are excluded per the project brief, since differential tests miss wheel-tag/packaging/min-OS changes and the publish Action never runs in PR CI. Grouped on its own so this batch can auto-merge -- a mixed group containing any manual-only member would never auto-merge.

dtolnay/rust-toolchain refs (stable, 1.81.0) are branches, not tags. A version-like ref such as the MSRV pin 1.81.0 is otherwise looked up as a tag, the lookup fails, and its digest is never refreshed. github-digest also resolves branches, and exact versioning keeps each ref as written, so only the digest moves and the MSRV pin is never bumped.

Leave canary.yml's Python to the maintainers: the rebuild canary runs on the Python that builds the abi3-py311 wheels, so Python is not one of the things that change between runs (MAINTENANCE.md, Weekly canary), and it moves by hand together with that abi3 floor.
Keep Rust and Python dependency changes together for CI review
Keep every pinned maturin reference (maturin-action version and the inline pip pin) moving together as one build-tool change; human review
PyO3 pre-1.0 updates always require human review
